description: Turn the 2 to 5 ideas the user liked into one giftgenius.io page: only those picks, each with the reason it fits, a photo and a price where there is one, and a link to buy it. Use it after find_gift_ideas, find_hobby_gifts or check_gift_idea, once the user has said which ideas they like. Pass the list_url of each result the picks came from and the picks' names as returned. The page is easy to decide from and to send to someone else who has a say.

list_urls.description: The list_url of each earlier result the picks came from (find_gift_ideas, find_hobby_gifts or check_gift_idea), up to 4. The first one says who the shortlist is for.

picks.description: Names of the 2 to 5 ideas the user liked, as the tools returned them, the favorite first.

name: make_gift_shortlist

why.description: Why this recipient will love it, addressed to the giver.

shortlist_url.description: One giftgenius.io page with only these picks and a link to buy each.

title: Make a gift shortlist
